verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a Namecheap XML API and a Go SDK. The SDK lists TLDs with their "per-TLD API capabilities" and has charge-bearing register and renew calls, but nothing shows an endpoint or feed that returns registration, renewal or transfer prices per TLD. A TLD capability listing and paid actions are adjacent features, not machine-readable pricing, so this applicable axis has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As a developer, pricing is machine-readable — an API or feed returns current registration/renewal/transfer prices per TLD so tooling can compare and budget
